Boundary fix samples

Each player plays word 1, 300 ms of silence, then word 2, cut at that version's boundary. Listen for word 1 ending cleanly (no start of word 2 left on it) and word 2 starting cleanly (nothing missing). Green tags are pairs you corrected: is NEW acceptable? Orange tags are pairs you accepted that the fix moves: is NEW still acceptable? Reply with ids, e.g. “F1-a ok, F1-c no”.
